definitions.explanation: A bell or electronic device at a door or entrance that visitors press to alert the occupants. Also used for service bells in hotels or restaurants.

examples.japanese: {呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鳴|な}らした→鳴らす：02381_narasu⟧。
{呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The doorbell rang, so I went to the front door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}した→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧こなかった。
examples.english: I pressed the doorbell many times, but nobody came out.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (calling, from ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧) and {鈴|りん} (bell). Refers to any bell or button used to summon someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鳴|な}らす→鳴らす：02381_narasu⟧: to ring the doorbell
- {呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to press the doorbell
- {呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: the doorbell rings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦チャイム→チャイム：00024_chaimu⟧: chime — modern electronic doorbell sound; more commonly used in everyday conversation
- ⟦インターホン→インターホン：04885_intaahon⟧: intercom — doorbell with a speaker/monitor, standard in Japanese apartments
- ⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧: bell — general term for bells; also used for doorbells

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, ⟦チャイム→チャイム：00024_chaimu⟧ and ⟦インターホン→インターホン：04885_intaahon⟧ are more commonly used for residential doorbells. {呼|よ}び{鈴|りん} has a slightly old-fashioned nuance but is still widely understood.
